title: How big will Leonida really be?
text: Okay, real talk. We've seen Vice City, the Keys and the swamps. How big do you think the whole map is compared to Los Santos? And honestly, would you even want it way bigger, or is there a sweet spot?

title: GTA Online after GTA 6
text: So what's going to happen with GTA Online? Fresh start for everyone, or do you think Rockstar lets us bring something over from GTA V? I've got a feeling, but I want to hear yours first.

title: Lucia and Jason's ending
text: The whole Bonnie and Clyde vibe has me worried. Do you think they both make it out? What ending would actually hit you the hardest?

title: Interiors everywhere?
text: Be honest, how many buildings do you think we can actually walk into? Malls, apartments, clubs? Which one are you hoping for the most?

title: Is story DLC finally coming back?
text: GTA IV had those amazing expansions and GTA V never got one. You think Rockstar brings story DLC back this time? What would you want it to be about?

title: The social media world in Leonida
text: The trailers are full of phone videos and viral clips. How do you think the in-game social media works? Imagine your own chaos going viral in the game...

title: Old characters returning?
text: Okay, who's showing up? Do you think we get cameos from old GTA characters in Leonida? Who would make you lose it, and who should stay retired?

title: How smart will the police be?
text: Smarter, more realistic cops sound cool... until you've got five stars and just want to get home. Where's the line for you between realistic and still fun?

title: Weather and hurricanes
text: It's Florida, so storms and floods kind of come with it. Do you think we get real hurricane events that change the map? Would you love that or hate it?

title: The radio in GTA 6
text: Vice City back in 2002 had one of the best soundtracks ever, no debate. What kind of stations and artists are you hoping for this time?

title: Wildlife in the swamps
text: Alligators are already confirmed, so you know it's going to get wild. What other animals do you think we run into? And are we getting hunting or fishing?

title: When does PC get it?
text: Consoles get it first, we all know that. But when do you think PC finally gets GTA 6? Are you waiting, or did you give up and grab a console?

title: The heist you want
text: If you could design one heist for GTA 6, what would it be? Bank, yacht, airport, a casino in the Keys? Go wild.

title: How long should the story be?
text: GTA V's story took most of us around 30 to 40 hours. How long should GTA 6 be? Is longer always better, or do you want it tight?

title: Easter eggs and mysteries
text: Remember the Mount Chiliad mystery? What kind of secret do you think Rockstar is hiding in Leonida this time? Any theories already?

title: Vice City then and now
text: What do you think Rockstar keeps from the old Vice City, and what feels totally new? Any spots you're hoping come back?

title: Car customization
text: How deep should car customization go? Is GTA V's level enough for you, or do you want something closer to a full racing game?

title: Property and businesses
text: Buying property in Vice City 2002 was such a vibe. Do you want businesses back in story mode? Which one are you buying first?

title: What should never change?
text: Every GTA has that one thing that just feels like GTA. What's the one thing Rockstar should never ever touch?

title: Biggest worry
text: The hype is insane, so let's be honest for a second. What's your biggest worry about GTA 6? What would actually disappoint you?

title: First week impressions
text: Alright, you've been in Leonida for a few days now. What surprised you the most, good or bad? Keep big story spoilers in spoiler tags, please.

title: Hidden details you found
text: Show me the smallest detail that blew your mind so far. Screenshots welcome, spoilers in spoiler tags.

title: What should the first update add?
text: Now that we're all playing, what's the first thing Rockstar should add or fix? I'm curious what's bugging you.
